note: Independent rejudgment 2026-11-24 against RFC 9072 Section 2 (rfc/full/rfc9072.txt): "(In any case, an implementation MUST accept an OPEN message that uses the encoding of this specification even if the length of the Optional Parameters is 255 or less.)" Verified commit 79815edae5: message/open.go UnpackOpen now detects extended framing via `optLen != 0 && len(data) > 10 && data[10] == 0xFF` per RFC 9072 Sections 2-3, accepting any Extended Optional Parameters Length including 0..255 with ExtendedParams=true. In TestOpenUnpackExtendedParams, the three tagged cases (classic 4-octet negative with type 0x02; extended 0-octet and 6-octet positives) are unchanged, and the updated untagged case additionally proves Non-Ext OP Len 4 + Non-Ext OP Type 0xFF + Extended Length 6 (<=255) decodes as extended. TestRFC9072ShortExtendedOpenIsAccepted (positive/negative) is unchanged and proves a 9-octet extended OPEN decodes with ExtendedParams=true all the way to ASN4 4200000001 while classic framing cannot recover it. Verdict stands: enforced.
